source_caption_text:
8 years ago today, Juice WRLD freestyled over Eminem beats for more than 50 minutes on Tim Westwood

Juice WRLD’s “Hour of Fire” freestyle with Tim Westwood is still one of the craziest displays of raw rap talent. He casually sat in a chair and freestyled for over an hour, using nothing but classic Eminem beats.

The wild part is how easily Juice locked into every beat Westwood threw at him. He was coming up with flows, punchlines and rhymes completely off the top of his head without sounding like he was even thinking about it.

Watching him go for that long without losing his rhythm or energy really showed how naturally freestyle came to him. R.I.P. Juice WRLD 🕊️

Via @timwestwoodtv
